name: Boss Delay Reduction

system.description:
This effect makes it so that Bosses can't be delayed more then 30% per Activation.

Note: This is referring to the total delay, if you first advance the boss by say 10%, that means it at that point can be delayed by 40%, it just can never be advanced more then -30% from its base value.
